segments.text: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki? The first surprise is that joining would not make him safe.
segments.label: THE WRONG SIDE OF THE STORY

segments.text: He carries the Nine Tails, and the Akatsuki wants the tailed beasts. Their new recruit is also their target.
segments.label: THE RECRUIT IS ALSO THE TARGET

segments.text: In this alternate timeline, Naruto offers a deal: his help, in exchange for protecting his friends.
segments.label: ONE DANGEROUS DEAL

segments.text: At first, the missions give him the respect he always wanted. But every favor comes with a price.
segments.label: TRUST COMES WITH A PRICE

segments.text: The breaking point arrives when his new allies demand that he turn against the Hidden Leaf.
segments.label: THEN COMES THE DEMAND

segments.text: He refuses. Now both sides question his loyalty, and the deal that protected his friends falls apart.
segments.label: HE REFUSES

segments.text: Naruto has to choose: prove himself to the organization, or protect the people who still believe in him.
segments.label: CHOOSE A SIDE

segments.text: Could he change the Akatsuki from inside? Or would joining them change Naruto first?
segments.label: WHO CHANGES WHOM?
